purpose: Select the ecological mucin-charge amplitude from same-image producer/plasmid-free-null contrasts at amplitudes 15, 20, and 30, the pending second Gate C evidence stream that the intrinsic single-source transport assay explicitly does not supply.

relationship_to_existing_packages.experiments/single_source_transport_assa: Intrinsic transport stream only (SS_amp, physical chemistry_placement=device). This package neither generates, preflights, nor submits SS_amp runs, and refuses SS_amp identities.
relationship_to_existing_packages.experiments/receptor_selection_campaign_: Historical staged campaign at ecological amplitudes 0/15/60. Its generated Stage C inputs are an immutable historical record; this package never reads, regenerates, or modifies them.

arms.producer: 60 ColE1 carriers (type 1) plus 60 plasmid-free susceptibles (type 2), unchanged ecological Stage C settings
arms.plasmid_free_null: identical geometry and settings with the type-1 ColE1 plasmid removed

design.null_amplitude_rationale: A plasmid-free null releases no colicin, so the mucin-charge retardation amplitude has no toxin to act on and the null is a valid shared control for all three producer amplitudes. The value is pinned to 15 so the three nulls are byte-identical across the amplitude axis and the authenticated amplitude of a null is unambiguous.

predeclared_analysis.composition_series: One point per agent snapshot: log10((n_type1 + 0.5) / (n_type2 + 0.5)), timed by the coincident summary time when present and by step * bio_dt otherwise.
predeclared_analysis.shared_calendar_window: A producer run is contrasted only against the plasmid-free null of its own seed on the shared window t in [t_common - 7200, t_common] with t_common = min(t_end_producer, t_end_null). Own-end windows are diagnostics and are never used in the selection.
predeclared_analysis.producer_null_slope: delta_slope = slope_producer - slope_null, each an ordinary least-squares slope of the composition series over the shared window, reported in log10 ratio per hour.
predeclared_analysis.final_susceptible_count: n_type2 at the final agent snapshot of the producer run.
predeclared_analysis.kills_per_producer_lysis: cumulative_mortality_colicin / cumulative_mortality_lysis at the final summary step.
predeclared_analysis.producer_division_denominator: Integer events/cumulative_divisions_by_type[1]. A file without that dataset leaves producer-normalized ratios missing; a composition-weighted proxy is never substituted.
predeclared_analysis.blocking: A missing, unreadable, or unauthenticated output blocks the gate. Absent values are never inferred as zero and a missing seed is never dropped from a median.

criteria_in_order: all three seed-level producer-null delta slopes are positive
the median of the three delta slopes lies in [0.25, 0.40] log10 ratio per hour, inclusive
the median final susceptible count is at least 1000 and no seed is below 500
among qualifying amplitudes, maximize the median kills per producer lysis
if a lower qualifying amplitude is within 10 percent of the maximum median kills per producer lysis, select the lower amplitude
selection_rule.fallback: If no amplitude qualifies, amplitude 15 is retained only when it reproduces the earlier ecological effect on this image, defined before execution as all three seed-level delta slopes positive and the median final susceptible count at least 500. The retention is recorded as fallback_reproduction_of_prior_effect and never satisfies the gate by itself.
selection_rule.no_post_hoc_amendment: This rule is fixed before any output of this package is read. Changing it after results exist voids the gate.

requires_all: all 12 runs returned a readable output file

every run authenticates against the execution source SHA, chemistry_placement=device_delivery, one MPI rank, its seed and amplitude, kd_corrinoid_btuB=1e-4, kd_colicinE_btuB=5e-7, b12_initial_conc=1e-3, burst_release_tau=300 s, the ColE1 release identity, and the declared HDF5 schedules
every run carries the same execution source SHA and the same immutable container image digest as the manifest
the intrinsic single_source_transport_gate passed on that same SHA and image digest
the predeclared selection rule resolves to one amplitude
an explicit operator approval names that exact SHA, image digest, and selected amplitude
gate.stage_d_release: Stage D remains BLOCKED until this gate is PASS; the analyzer never promotes Stage D and never writes an approval.

lineage.reason: PR419 delivery-authentication ancestry; the intrinsic assay that supplies the first Gate C stream is only meaningful at or after this commit.

execution_source_sha_policy.rule: Deployment generation requires --deployment, a full 40-hex SHA equal to git HEAD, a clean committed package, and an immutable image digest.
